fullContent:
Garbha Chintamani Ras 
 Reference: Ayurved sar sangrah 17th edition, page 280-281. 
 Garbha Chintamani Ras is an Ayurvedic medicine available in tablet form. It is used in the treatment of pregnancy related problems like Burning sensation during pregnancy, Pyrexia during pregnancy. 
 Ingredients 
 10 g fine powder of each of:- 
 
 Shuddha Parada – purified Mercury 
 Shuddha Gandhaka – purified Sulphur 
 Swarna Bhasma – Bhasma of Gold 
 Loha Bhasma – Bhasma prepared from Iron 
 Rajata Bhasma – Bhasma of Silver 
 Makshika Bhasma – Bhasma of Copper-Iron Pyrite 
 Shuddha Haratala – Purified and processed Orpiment (Arsenic tri sulphide) 
 Vanga Bhasma – Tin Calx 
 Abhraka Bhasma – Purified and processed Mica 
 
 Quantity sufficient of Juice extract/decoction of:- 
 
 Brahmi – Bacopa monnieri 
 Vasa – Adhatoda vasica 
 Bhringaraja – Eclipta alba 
 Parpataka – Hedyotis corymbosa 
 Dashamoola – group of 10 roots 
 
 How to Make? 
 Make fine power of above ingredients and mix with juice extract or decoction seven times and make into paste and finally pills are prepared. 
 Dosage 
 
 250 mg once or twice a day, before or after food or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 It is traditionally administered along with honey. 
 
 Indications 
 
 Menorrhagia 
 Leucorrhea 
 Burning sensation during pregnancy 
 Pyrexia during pregnancy 
 Postpartum disorder 
 Puerperal disorders 
 Low appetite, vomiting, diarrhea, weakness etc. during pregnancy 
 Morning sickness, vomiting and weakness 
 Fever, Cough, leucorrhoea during pregnancy 
 
 Side Effects 
 
 Self-medication with this medicine may prove to be dangerous contains heavy metal ingredients, hence should only be taken under strict medical supervision. 
 Take this medicine in precise dose and for limited period of time, as advised by doctor. 
 Over-dosage may cause severe poisonous effect. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
